projects.title: Electrific – Autonomous Multilingual Email & Quotation Agent
projects.description: Architected and delivered an enterprise-grade autonomous email agent for an electrical distributor operating across Bahrain and Saudi Arabia. The system intercepts inbound customer enquiries via webhooks, performs Arabic & English conversational NLP with OCR document extraction, syncs live stock and dynamic multi-tier pricing from a PostgreSQL catalog, calculates local currency and tax rules (BHD/SAR), renders formal bilingual PDF/HTML quotations, and integrates Stripe and Moyasar payment gateways to convert enquiries directly into paid orders with zero human intervention.
features: Delivered a fully automated email agent that took over inbound customer product enquiries end to end across Bahrain and Saudi Arabia
Enabled the agent to answer in the customer's own language (Arabic & English) and return a formal priced quotation complete with product images, specifications and a live payment link
Kept every quotation accurate against live stock and pricing by syncing the client's PostgreSQL product catalog several times a day
Automated the collection and fallback enrichment of supporting product data so the agent could answer confidently on items with incomplete catalog records
Integrated payment gateways (Stripe & Moyasar) to generate secure, itemized checkout sessions automatically
Multi-modal input support parsing incoming RFQ emails, attachments, spreadsheets, and spec sheet images via OCR

projects.title: Multilingual NexusRAG – Document Intelligence Platform
projects.description: Built a production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platform that lets users interrogate their own documents conversationally in Arabic and other languages, including full native RTL rendering. Shipped as a working multi-user product with authentication, session persistence, and confidence scoring with source previews so users can verify exactly where each answer came from.
features: Production-grade RAG system supporting conversational document interrogation in Arabic and 100+ languages with full native RTL rendering
Shipped as a working multi-user product with Firebase Authentication and SQLite session persistence
Dual retrieval modes: strict document-only verification and hybrid conversational querying
Confidence scoring with source transparency and chunk previews showing exact origin citations
Multi-session management with message branching, export functionality, and comprehensive document panel
Automated document expiration and background cleanup mechanisms for data privacy and security

projects.title: DeepDeception – Deepfake Detection System
projects.description: Trained an XceptionNet deepfake classifier to 85.9% accuracy across a 53,400-frame test set and put it behind a public web interface anyone can test. Selected for Artificial Intelligence Innofest 2024 and presented to industry evaluators.
features: Trained an XceptionNet deepfake classifier achieving 85.9% accuracy across a 53,400-frame test set
Selected for Artificial Intelligence Innofest 2024 and presented to industry evaluators
Scalable Django REST API supporting 100+ concurrent user inference sessions
GPU acceleration on cloud instances achieving 60% reduction in training iteration time
User-friendly web interface with drag-and-drop video upload and real-time frame analysis
Detailed confidence scoring and comprehensive forensic inspection reports

projects.title: Maze of Fury – Unity FPS with AI Enemies
projects.description: First-person shooting experience set within a labyrinthine maze featuring navmesh-driven AI enemy behaviors, multi-level pathfinding, and dynamic health systems built in Unity 3D.

Responsive and challenging enemy AI behavior using NavMesh

projects.title: Self-Driving Car Simulation
projects.description: An autonomous vehicle simulation system built using CNN-based computer vision and behavioral cloning techniques. Replicates autonomous driving pipelines, predicting steering angle and speed control across diverse simulated tracks.
features: CNN-based vision system for road analysis
Behavioral cloning from human driving data
Real-time steering angle prediction and speed control
Integration with Unity-based Udacity simulator
Two distinct tracks: Lake track and Jungle track
Training mode for data collection and autonomous mode for testing
